title: Grinberg and Puharich meet during Puharich's Mexican exile
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Grinberg and Puharich meet during Puharich's Mexican exile, about 1980s at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, they met. When Puharich was in exile in Mexico after his house was was burned, uh they were they met in Mexico.

plain: An unnamed researcher on Jesse Michels' podcast says that two scientists of the strange met in Mexico in the 1980s: Jacobo Grinberg, a Mexican brain researcher, and Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode links to the CIA and to contact with an alien council. The guest says Puharich was living in exile in Mexico after his house was burned, and that is where the two met. If true, it would connect two key figures in this kind of research.
